labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Needs review by a collaborator before an agent may start it

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Agreed, with a plan in the issue body, so an agent may start it

labels.name: with-agent
labels.description: An agent owns the issue and its PR, so its plan is frozen

labels.name: agent-blocked
labels.description: An agent stopped on a question, and needs triage again

labels.name: agent-failed
labels.description: An agent run failed, and a collaborator checks why before a retry

labels.name: with-collaborator
labels.description: A collaborator owns the issue, so agents start no new work on it

labels.name: external-report
labels.description: Opened by someone other than a collaborator or an agent, so never worked on
